name: android-tv-controller
description: Control Chromecast, Samsung, LG, Roku and Android TVs from your Mac or Windows desktop

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run bundle:preload && npm run copy:static
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/remote-input.test.js test/playback.test.js test/samsung-lifecycle.test.js test/credential-storage.test.js && node test/deeplink.test.js && node test/activity.test.js && node test/remote-session.test.js && node test/pairing.test.js && node test/stress.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux --publish never
scripts.stress: npm run build && node test/stress.test.js && node test/stress-drivers.test.js
